neighbours.label: In passages of several lines that each end in a semicolon (code statements, bulleted or numbered lists, verse), the last word of a line just before its ';', written attached to the word (not French-style ' ;'). Quiet or weak for the same lines ending in '.', ',' or nothing, and for semicolons inside one running sentence. Exception: the French piece ' rel' in relâchés also fires.
